༄༅/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad gzungs sngags dang bcas pa bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad gzungs sngags dang bcas pa bzhugs so//

༄༅// thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan snying rje'i tsandan dri zhim po'i spos kyis byugs pa'i sku/ zhabs pad lha dang lha ma yin gyi nor bu'i cod pan gyis gtugs pa/ rang byung sel mdzad/ bla ma 'jig rten thams cad la phan mdzad pa/ ston pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa/ thub pa/ nyes pa dang bral ba/ zhi ba'i bdag nyid can/ gzugs mdzes pa/ mtshan gsal ba'i gzi brjid can/ sku dpe byad kyis brgyan pa/ yon tan thams cad yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo// padma rgyas pa ltar zhal bzhad de/ tshems dkar zhing snyoms la thags bzang bas rab tu rgyas shing snang la nor bu dri ma med pa ltar 'od gsal zhing mdzes te/ spa zhing gsal ba/ nyi ma'i 'od zer stong 'bar ba mang po'i 'od snang ba'i dkyil 'khor zil gyis gnon pa/ thub pa'i mchog stobs bcu dang ldan pa la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dud do// rab tu 'dud do// bstod do// oṃ bho hūṃ hūṃ/ ā ā/ hī hī/ shi ba shi ba/ shāṃ ti shāṃ ti/ sha ma sha ma sha ma pa ya/ ta thā ga ta a nu ga te/ swa bhā wa/ a bhā wa/ sa mud tā ya/ a sa ma ba la/ a ba ri la ba la/ a mṛ ta ba la/ a ti ba la/ ghuṃ ghuṃ/ dhau dhau/ bhrau bhrau/ bhre du bhre du/ hī hī/ bha ga wān/ bha wān ta ka /su ra ta bho ga ma hā shaṃ ti ka ra/ pā pa kelbi ṣa na sha ka swā hā/ de nas dpe byad mtshan gsal bas// yan lag thams cad rab brgyan cing*// nyi ma bzhin du gsal ba po// 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor rgyan mnga' ba// grags shing dri ma rab spangs la// dri med skyon bral chos kyi blo// khyab bdag chen po stobs bcu ldan// rdul bral dpal dang ldan pa po// rin chen sa gzhi chen po la// pho brang rtse mo rdo rje'i rtse// rgyal ba'i sras rnams gnas gyur pa// nor bu du ma rab 'phro zhing*// 'od zer dri med gsal bkod pa'i// rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor pho brang na// thub pa'i longs spyod sa gzhi la// seng ge'i khri chen yangs la bzhugs// nor bu dbyig gi sa gzhi dang*// khri chen rab spa de nyid la// de bzhin gshegs pa dgyes chen gyis// phun sum tshogs pa rgyan ko lta// thub pa me zla nor bu'i 'od// nyi zer gnon pa'i 'od ldan pa// bde blag shin tu bkra shis tshul// 'od gsal skyil mo krung bcas nas// sku 'od 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor can// 'od gsal rgyas pas thub dbang gi

/dri med 'od zer bkye ba ni// mi g.yo rdo rje can zhes bya// dkyil 'khor chen por bzhugs pa yi// rdo rje can dag rab btul ba// gang yin de kun dag byas nas// dkyil 'khor dri med skor bar bar byed// ngan song dam tshig dri ma kun// legs par shin tu dag byas nas// srid gsum dkyil 'khor rgya che ba// rnam pa du mar 'od gsal ba// 'gro dang mi 'gro ma lus pa// bskor nas bde chen rdo rje can// rdo rje ral gri thogs pa de// cod pan ma g.yos nang du bzhugs// de nas 'jigs pa'i sgra skad kyis// 'gengs shing mig ni glog ltar 'gyu// rig sngags hūṃ zhes sgrogs pa po// rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs byed pa// bzhin mdzes 'dzum gyis rnam par brgyan// bsdigs byed mig rtsa rgod gyur cing*// stan las langs te phyag 'tshal nas// legs par mchod byas smras pa ni// kye ma skye ba'i phyogs 'joms shing*// bskal pa du ma'i dri ma sel// rig sngags yon tan sgrub byed pa// thub mchog rnams kyis rab tu gsungs// de gzigs dge ba du ma brnyes// sangs rgyas blo gros rgyas par 'gyur/ byang chub sems dpa' blo gros che// bskal pa gcig tu spyod pas kyang*// brgyud mar sangs rgyas kun 'byung zhing*// spyod ma du ma 'byung ba yi// yon tan brgya yi spos ldan yang*// thos pa spro bar mi nus so// longs spyod rgya mtsho chen po can// byang chub sems mchog dkyil 'khor du// rgyal mchog rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i// phyir mi ldog pa'i chos can ldan// 'di thos sangs rgyas spyod pa yis// sems can kun gyi sdig pa rnams// ma lus rab tu bsal nas ni/ blo chen dri ma med par 'gyur// zhi zhing dag byed bkra shis la// rdul med brgyan te zhi bar byed// dge zhing mya ngan thams cad sel// sdug bsngal thams cad nges par 'joms// dbang byed gsang sngags dam pa ste// sa steng sdig pa thams cad sol// ma rmos 'bras bu nges par sbyin// bstan pa yin te sdang ba 'dul// nyes pa byas pa sel ba yin// gzungs 'di gang gis thob gyur te// sangs rgyas rnyed par dka' ba yang*// ring por mi thogs thob par 'gyur// sgrib pa thams cad rab zhi zhing*// khyab bdag nyon mongs kun sel ba// gang zhig nyon mongs zhi byed pa'i// gzungs 'di 'chang bar byed pa yis// kun tu bzang po nyid dang ni// lag na rdo rje nyid kyang 'thob// rig sngags 'chang gi bdag po yang*// 'di thos pas ni thob par 'gyur// 'jig rten kun na lam me ba// bcom ldan rnam par snang mdzad kyang*// dkyil 'khor dam pa gting med pa// 'di ni ji srid ma gsan par// rab zhi nyon mongs 'dul ba yi// rang byung go 'phang ma brnyes te// rnam par dag phyir gsan gyur nas// gsan ma thag tu rnam par dag

/de phyir phun sum tshogs pa dang*// legs par 'dod pas brjod par bya// gzhan gyis mi thub gzungs gsan nas// thub pa kun gyis gang brnyes pa// 'khor ba 'dir ni nam du yang*/ bdud kyi las dang 'khrug med dang*// mya ngan med cing 'thab med pa// gzungs la gnas pas thob par 'gyur// gnas kyi dam pa thob nas kyang*// thub pa dri ma med pa'i blo// gzigs pa bzang rnams gar gshegs pa'i// bzang 'gro der ni 'gro bar 'gyur// legs pa 'dod pa rnams kyis ni/ tshig gi mdo 'di mnyan par gyis// nyon mongs zad par bya ba la// rgyal bas gsungs pa'i gzungs 'di mchog /sdig pa byed cing dge las spangs// sdig pa'i rang bzhin rab 'jungs pa// gang gis thos nas de spong ba// de yi mngon sum 'byong bar 'gyur// sdig pa gzhan yang mi bya zhing*// snga ma rnams kyang bshags par bya// gzungs mchog 'di yi mthu stobs kyis// sdig pa thams cad 'byang bar 'gyur// tshe rabs gzhan ni stong dag dang*// tshe rabs bye ba phrag brgyar yang*// sdig pa mi dge gang byas pa// dag 'gyur 'di la the tshom med// yar gyi ngo na tshes brgyad dang*// de bzhin tshes ni bco lnga la// bsnyen gnas legs par lhur blangs la// cho ga bzhin du sangs rgyas mchod// de nas rmongs pa med par yang*// nyon mongs dgra ni rab 'joms shing*// shin tu thub dka' dpe med pa// nyes pa bzlog pa'i gzungs brjod na// thub pa'i zhal gyi zla ba'i 'od// thar pa nges par mthong bar 'gyur// des na tshogs rnams rdzogs pa yi// rgyal ba'i sras po nyid du 'gyur// 'od dpag med la mnga' ba yi// yon tan mtha' yas rab rgyas pa// bskal ba bye ba stong du yang*// mtha' mi rtogs pa thob par 'gyur// de nas rdo rje 'dzin gyi tshig /dkyil 'khor dag na gnas rnams kyis// thos nas rgyal rnams sna tshogs pa/ bcom ldan 'das la 'bul bar byed// rdo rje ral gri la sogs pa// lha dag gsal ba thams cad dang*// ri bo te si ri rab la// gnas pa'i rig sngags 'chang rnams dang*// de bzhin dkyil 'khor chen po na// 'khod pa'i rig sngags 'chang rnams dang*// ma la ya yi ri bo la// gnas shing rgyan 'bar thogs rnams dang*// khyab 'jug lha chen la sogs pa// lha yi bdag po rnams dang ni// lag na rdo rje la sogs pa/

byang chub sems dpa' stobs can rnams/ nor bu'i dpung rgyan rna cha dang*// rgyan rnams rab tu g.yo ba'i lus// rab tu bskyod de langs nas ni// sdig bral mnga' bdag rgyal ba la/ phyag 'tshal thal mo sbyar byas nas// kun gyis sa yi dbang phyug go /thub mchog dam pa de la ni// mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad dag gis bstod// mnyam nyid chos te de bzhin nyid// shin tu rtogs pa lam me ba// dul ba brtan pa dri ma sel// thub pa sangs rgyas shan tu zhi// 'jig rten mgon po skye dgu'i bdag /de bzhin gshegs pa nyon mongs thul// de bzhin rgyal ba rdul bsal ba// ston pa ston mdzad brten pa sde// sdig pa med pa rdul dang bral// 'jig rten mgon mdzad snang mdzad pa// dag pa zhi ba zas gtsang sras// nyon mongs rab bcom phan 'dogs pa// ston pa po ste dri ma sel// spyod tshul dri med tshul bzang ba// zab pa rnam par gnon pa brtan/ btsan po thugs brtse rnam par rgyal// mgon po de bzhin mgon mdzad pa// zhi ba'i bdag nyid zhe sdang bral/ bcings pa las grol nges par grol// 'jig rten kun mchog 'khra ba'i sa// bdag gir mi 'dzin dri ma med// ngan song sel ba dpal dang ldan// dpal mdzad de bzhin phan pa mdzad// mnyam pa med pa dpe med pa// khyab bdag nyon mongs las rnams spongs// khengs pa med pa dman pa med// mnyam pa de bzhin mi mnyam mnyam// snang ba brnyes pa snang byed med// 'jig rten snang mdzad sdig med pa// sgrib pa thams cad spangs pa ste// 'jig rten kun la phan par brtson// dpa' bo zhi ba zhi mdzad pa// nyon mongs dgra rnams zad par mdzad// mnga' bdag thabs mkhyen thabs che ba// sems can kun gyi 'khra sa lags// don yod rnyed dka' blo dang ldan// rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor thub pa dka'// skyob pa 'jigs sel tshangs pa ste// de bzhin sangs rgyas chos 'dzin pa// dpa' bo chen po 'jigs pa med// gzugs bzang mtshan rnams gsal ba ste// sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan mnga' ba// chos kyi longs spyod rgya mtsho lags// dpe byad bzang po bkod pa yis// spras pa'i bdag nyid ya mtshan ston// dka' med pa yi ston pa po// de bzhin nges pa bde sbyin pa// mthu can yangs pa rgya che ba/

bdud bzhi'i stobs rnams sel mdzad pa// brtson chen spro ba che ba ste// dgyes pa chen po stobs po che// mthu brnyes brtan po chen po ste// gnas ldan dbang gis dar ba lags// gsal ba gsung na dpe med pa// dge ba stong pa nyid kyis rgyal// rab tu zhi ba mun pa med/ blo gros chen po chos 'dzin pa// phun sum tshogs lnga gnas chen brnyes// 'dod pa rnams ni 'dul mdzad pa// dpal mdzad dpal mnga' dpal dang ldan// dpal gyi longs spyod shin tu rgyas// bcom ldan legs bsgos bsgo bar mdzad// gsung ldan bkra shis rgyal po'i gnas// mnyam nyid mnyam pa nyid mkhyen pa// mnyam pa nyid kyis mtshan dpag med// rab tu dgyes pa longs spyod gsal// gzhi bcas sems pa mnyam pa lags/ blo dag blo ldan dri ma spangs// gnas chen brtan par ldan pa ste/ rgyas pa longs spyod dri ma med// thub pa thugs rje'i rgyan mnga' ba// skal pa bzang po 'jigs pa'i skyabs// de bzhin 'jigs med nyon mongs sa sel// dri med skyon bral longs spyod can// sna tshogs 'od ldan dkyil 'khor mdzad// sku bzang dge ba'i rim pa mchog /thugs rje'i 'od ldan 'od bzang ba// mi gnas longs spyod dam pa lags// chos kyi rgyu de yon tan gnas// rjed 'os mchog ni longs spyod che/ nam mkha'i mtshan de rnam dag blo// rin chen gzugs 'dra bkra shis pa// khyu mchog che spyan ba rdzi ma/ rgyal ba skyon bsal shes rab can// shes rab thabs dang ldan pa ste// 'jig rten mi dge kun las 'das// dag par longs spyod brtan pa can// sa dang stobs dang ye shes bzod// pha rol phyin pa kun la mnga'// ting 'dzin mnyam par longs spyod pa// rnam thar sgo la mngon sum pa// gtong ba sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam// chos chen bde bar 'char ba lags// thams cad mkhyen pa'i yul las 'das// spyod yul sgrib pa mi mnga' ba// byang chub sems dpa'i dbang po rgyal// dam pa'i don te tshul che ba// shes bya'i yul rnams mtha' dag la// sgrib pa med par 'char ba brnyes// rigs chen mthun par skyes pa ste// de bzhin gshegs pa'i dge ba'i gnas// khyad par brnyes pa mnyam nyid brnyes// mi mnyam sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam// don chen shin tu mthar phyin pa// nyon mongs bral ba thub par dka'// dge spyod sdig pa sbyong mdzad pa// gnod pa med par bde bar 'byin// blo rgya che ba thams cad mkhyen// thos pa'i mtshon cha ma lus gsan// dkon pa bde ba thob gyur ba// mnyam pa khyad par yul dang ldan// 'jig rten thams cad dar mdzad mgon/

zhi gnas mtshon cha thub pa dka'// bsam gyis mi khyab bsam yas yul// dpe med pa ste dper bya ba// 'od bzang rab dgyes dpal dang ldan// legs gsung blo yi stobs kyis 'byung*// mkhas pa zhal bzang bde sbyin pa// rab dgyes 'das pa'i spyod yul can// gsang ba chen po ye shes che// gnas chen bkra shis chen po ste/ mchod par gyur pa yul las 'das// bya ba'i mtshan nyid med pa po// sangs rgyas yul du skyes pa ste// shes bya'i spyod yul rgya che ba// kun mkhyen longs spyod 'bras bu can// 'jig rten dbang 'das spyod yul ba// kun mkhyen yul gyi snang ba ste// thabs mnga' phun sum tshogs ldan pa// rdzu 'phrul rol pa'i thabs dang ldan// chos kyi gar stabs ston pa po// rab ston yon tan sgyur mdzad pa// spyod pa ma lus 'dul bar mdzad// yongs su rdzogs pa rnam par dag /sangs rgyas spyod yul rnam sangs rgyas// bgegs byed ma legs byed pa bcom// bdud kyi dregs pa sel bar mdzad// g.yul ngor rnam par rgyal ba brnyes// dpa' bo chen po pham med stobs// theg pa chen po shing rtar bcibs/ blo chen brgal bar dka' ba yi/ nyon mongs rgya mtsho'i pha rol gshegs// theg pa chen po'i tshul la gnas// theg pa mchog la longs spyod pa// nyan thos 'das pa'i spyod yul can// rang rgyal las kyang 'das pa ste// sangs rgyas sa yi 'bras bur gnas// gong nas gong du khyad par mkhyen// khyod ni nam mkha'i gnas na bzhugs// bde 'byung sa dang zhing rnams kyi// mtsho chen dag la longs par spyod// sangs rgyas dbang po rgyas pa la// mtshan rgya rtsa brgyad kyis bstod nas// de la lha sogs tshogs rnams kyis/ phyag byas mgo smad phyogs gcig 'khod// de nas dkyil 'khor chen po ni// gnas pa ma lus chem mer 'khod// thod du rdo rje'i thod 'ching ba// langs nas cod pan rab tu g.yos// dkyil 'khor mthon po thams cad du// skad ber chen pos yongs bkang nas// nor bu'i rgyan ni rnam g.yo zhing*// ha ha grags pa'i sgra sgrogs te// kye ma sangs rgyas yon tan che// bskal pa grangs med gsum bsags pa/

byang chub sems sogs mchog rnams kyis/ mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad legs par brjod// kye ma rnyed dang bde 'byung ba// mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad thos nas kyang*// gang zhig klog cing rgyal la bstod// 'bras bu chen po 'grub par 'gyur// mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad sngags bcas pa// bcom ldan 'das drung brjod na ni// sgrib dang kun nas nyon mongs dang*// sdig pa thams cad dag pa mthong*// mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad mchog bton na// sgrib pa kun las nges grol zhing*// nyon mongs mtha' dag rnam par spong*// shes rab chen po nyid du 'gyur/ de ni longs spyod chen po dang*/ bde ba las kyang nyams mi 'gyur// de yi tshe rabs thams cad du// blo ldan tshe rabs dran par 'gyur// de nas rdo rje'i thod 'ching pa// yon tan mtha' yas sras de la/ bcom ldan bdud las rgyal ba yis// mngon sum gzigs nas bka' stsal pa// rgyal ba'i sa 'di zhi ba ste// nga rgyal la sogs nyon mongs 'joms// 'jig rten bde ba kun las 'das// de bzhin gshegs de mngon du phyogs// gzhan gyis mi tshugs gzungs dang ni// mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad nyan byed pa// de dag rnam dag bdag nyid de// sems can kun la bde 'dod pa// lan gcig thos pa tsam gyis kyang*// de dag sa chen 'bras bur gnas// ring por mi thogs dgar 'gyur na// 'chang sogs lta la ci zhig smos// de phyir rtag tu rab bsgrims la// gtan du bde ba 'dod pa yis// yon tan rgya mtsho ldan pa'i gzungs// mnyan par bya zhing bcang bar bya// gang zhig nad pas langs nas brjod// bdag nyid kyis kyang bton ni// de yi don kun 'grub 'gyur la// gnod pa dang yang phrad mi 'gyur// 'di ni yon tan kun gyi spos// dge ba phun sum tshogs sbyin pa// kun mkhyen bla med 'bras bu'i mchog /bde 'byung thob par byed pa yin// 'bras bu 'byor ba ci yang rung*// thob par mi 'gyur dogs pa med// kun mkhyen go 'phang thob gyur nas// dpe med gnas su 'gro bar 'gyur// de ni dge zhing 'bras bu ldan// sangs rgyas sa yi 'bras bu byin// yid du 'ong zhing yon tan ldan// snying rje dri ma med byin pa// 'di ni mnyam pa nyid kyi mdo// 'jig rten kun nas dga' ba ste// 'jig rten kun gyi bde 'byung ba// 'di dang 'dra ba gang yang med// ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa rdzogs so/// /

༈ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal lo// tadya thā/ mu ne mu ne ma hā mu ne ye swā hā/ lan gcig bzlas brjod byas na bskal pa bye ba brgya phrag brgyad khri'i bar du sdig pa byas pa gang yin pa de dag thams cad byang bar 'gyur ro// 'phags pa shākya thub pa'i snying po'i gzungs rdzogs so/// / ༈ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'phags pa rnam par snang mdzad 'od kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i snying po la phyag 'tshal lo// tadya thā/ ka la ka la/ ki li ki li// bi ri bi ri/ hu ru hu ru// be ro tsa na raṣmi sañtso di ta ā gatstsha/ ārya ā gā sha garbha ma hā kā ru ṇi kā pu ra ya ha shā na dha ra ya buddha pa ṣi tsa ya na/ tsa ra tsa ra tsi ri tsi ri swā hā/ bton pas 'grub ste/ mtshon cha dang*/ me dang*/ chu dang*/ dug dang*/ dug sbyar ma dang*/ byad stems rnams kyis mi tshugs so// rgyal pa dang chom rkun la sogs pa thams cad kyis glags mi rnyed do// gang du bris te bzhag pa der yams kyi nad dang*/ gnod pa dang*/ 'go ba'i nad thams cad mi 'byung bar 'gyur ro// dri ma med pa'i 'od ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin kyang thob par 'gyur ro// 'phags pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi snying po zhes bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs so/// / ༈ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dang snying rje chen po dang ldan pa 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po la phyag 'tshal lo// tadya thā/ badzra ma bu/ badzra ma bu/ buddha badzre/ badzra ma bu buddha badzre/ shū n+ya ta pra bha she/ bai ro tsa na garbhe/ pañtse di ya/ a ba bo dhi na swā hā/

cho ga ni rtag tu bzlas brjod byas na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas pa thob par 'gyur ro// bdud thams cad dang*/ dgra thams cad dang*/ log 'dren thams cad kyis mi tshugs so// 'chi ba'i tshe 'phags pa 'od dpag med mthong bar 'gyur ro// de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyang mthong bar 'gyur ro// ji ltar smon lam btab pa bzhin du skye bar 'gyur ro// rdzogs so/// / ༈ zla ba'i 'od de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo// tadya thā/ tsand+re tsand+re/ su tsand+ra/ ma ti tsand+ra/ tsand+ra ka ra ṇa/ si ri si ri/ buddha a dhiṣṭhī te/ ki li ki li/ dharma a dhiṣṭhī te/ ki li ki li/ saṅgha a dhiṣṭhī te swā hā/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang gis rtag tu nang par langs te/ zla ba'i 'od de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan dran par byed pa de ni bskal pa bzhi khrir tshe rabs dran par 'gyur te/ de ni ngan song du ltung bar mi 'gyur ro// zla ba'i 'od kyi mtshan rjes su dran pas yon tan de rnams 'thob par 'gyur ro// zla ba'i 'od kyi mtshan rjes su dran pa rdzogs so/// / ༈ namaḥ sarba ta thā ga ta hri da ya/ a nu ga te/ oṃ ku ruṃ gi ni swā hā/ 'di lan gcig bzlas pas bskal pa 'bum phrag brgyad stong du bsags pa'i las kyi sgrib pa yang zad par 'gyur ro// de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyi'i snying po rjes su dran pa rdzogs so/// / ༈ sangs rgyas rin chen gtsug tor can la phyag 'tshal lo// na mo ratna shi khe ne/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arha te samyaksam buddha ya/ tadya thā/ ratne ratne ratna shi khe ne swā hā// 'chi ba'i tshe dran na ngan song kun las rnam par grol bar 'gyur/ shi 'phos nas kyang sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lhar skye'o// sangs rgyas rin chen gtsug tor can gyi mtshan rjes su dran pa rdzogs so/// /dge legs 'phel/
